NSCameraUsageDescription: 6pm uses the camera to read VietQR codes when you scan to pay.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: 6pm listens while you hold to say a spend. What you say is understood on this iPhone.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: 6pm turns what you say into an amount and a name, on this iPhone. Nothing is sent anywhere.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: 6pm saves your close receipt and money diary to Photos when you ask it to.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: 6pm checks which country you are in so Travel mode can turn on by itself abroad.
